name: Moroccan Bank Impersonation / OTP Hijack
name_ar: انتحال صفة بنك مغربي وسرقة رمز التأكيد
target: OTP, password, online banking credentials, RIB
description: Scammer poses as a Moroccan bank (CIH, Attijariwafa, Banque Populaire, etc.) claiming an urgent problem, locked card, or fraudulent transaction, and requests the one-time SMS verification code (OTP) or online banking credentials.
advice: Banks NEVER ask for OTP or password over phone, SMS or WhatsApp. Immediately contact your bank branch directly.
report_to: DGST / DGSN Cybercrime Unit, Bank Fraud Department

name: Fake CNSS / CNOPS / DGI Health & Tax Refund
name_ar: احتيال استرجاع مصاريف الضمان الاجتماعي والضرائب
target: Credit card number, CVV, CIN, RIB
description: Phishing message masquerading as CNSS (Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale) or CNOPS promising an unexpected reimbursement for medical expenses or tax credit, linking to a fake portal asking for bank card details.
advice: CNSS pays directly via your declared RIB, never asks for credit card numbers or CVV. Check your space on macnss.ma.

name: Barid Al-Maghrib / Amana / Chronopost Parcel Delivery Fee
name_fr: Frais de Colis Suspendu Poste / Amana / Chronopost
name_ar: احتيال رسوم طرد بريدي معلق بريد المغرب وأمانة
target: Bank card details, payment of 15-30 DH
description: SMS or WhatsApp claiming a parcel is stuck at the sorting facility or customs due to unpaid delivery fee (usually 15 to 30 DH) or missing address, redirecting to a cloned phishing payment gateway.
advice: Barid Al-Maghrib and Amana deliver with payment on delivery (COD) or notify via official slips. Never enter card details on unverified shortlinks.

name: Inwi / Orange / IAM Lottery & Gift Fraud
name_fr: Arnaque Loterie Télécom (Maroc Telecom, Orange, Inwi)
name_ar: احتيال جوائز الاتصالات (اتصالات المغرب، أورنج، إنوي)
target: Recharge scratch cards, CIN copy, upfront processing fee
description: Bogus prize announcement claiming you won cash, a car, or the latest smartphone from a telecom carrier, demanding that you send prepaid recharge scratch cards or send your national ID card (CIN).
advice: Telecom operators announce winners exclusively on their verified platforms and never require prepaid card transfers to release prizes.

name: WhatsApp 6-Digit Verification Code Hijack
name_fr: Piratage de compte WhatsApp par code à 6 chiffres
name_ar: اختراق حساب واتساب عبر رمز التحقق المكون من 6 أرقام
description: An attacker attempts to register your WhatsApp on their device and sends a message (often from a compromised friend's account) claiming they mistakenly entered your number and asking you to forward the 6-digit SMS code.
advice: NEVER share verification codes with anyone, even contacts claiming an emergency. Enable 2-step verification with a PIN in WhatsApp settings.

name: Fake Employment / Gulf & European Visa Contract
name_fr: Fausse Offre d'Emploi avec Frais Préalables
name_ar: عروض عمل وهمية وطلب رسوم ملف أو فيزا مسبقة
target: Wafacash / Cash Plus money transfer, passport / CIN scan
description: Lucrative job offers abroad (Canada, UAE, Europe, cruise ships) or simple online task-based jobs that demand upfront payments for 'medical checkup', 'work permit dossier', or registration fees.
advice: Legitimate employers never demand upfront fees from candidates before employment. Verified recruitment agencies are strictly regulated by ANAPEC in Morocco.

name: VIP Crypto & Forex Telegram Investment Doubler
name_fr: Arnaque Crypto / Trading Telegram / Rendement Garanti
name_ar: مجموعات تيليغرام للاستثمار ومضاعفة العملات الرقمية
description: Promises of 200% to 500% guaranteed returns within 24 to 72 hours via automated crypto trading or Binance deposits in closed Telegram/WhatsApp groups.
advice: Guaranteed high returns in cryptocurrency do not exist. Any group promising risk-free multiplier returns is a Ponzi scheme.

name: Avito / Marketplace Fake Payment Gateway & Delivery Trap
name_fr: Faux Acheteur Avito / Fausse Passerelle de Paiement
name_ar: مشتري وهمي على أفيتو وروابط استلام الأموال المزيفة
target: Credit card credentials on fake 'receive money' page
description: A buyer on Avito or Facebook Marketplace insists on paying immediately online via a fake link where the seller is asked to 'enter credit card details to receive the funds'.
advice: To receive money, you only need your RIB (bank account number). Never input card numbers, expiration date, or CVV to receive money.

name: Urgent Family Emergency / Police Custody / Hospital Bail
name_fr: Urgence Familiale Factice / Accident / Garde à Vue
name_ar: طوارئ عائلية مفبركة / حادثة سير / حراسة نظرية
target: Immediate Cash Plus / Wafacash wire transfer
description: Message from an unknown or spoofed number pretending to be a son, daughter, or close relative stating they were in a car crash, arrested, or hospitalized and need immediate untraceable money transfer.
advice: Always call your relative on their known phone number or contact other family members directly before sending any funds.

name: Vacation / Long-term Rental Advance Deposit Fraud
name_fr: Arnaque à la Caution de Location Immobilière
name_ar: احتيال تسبيق كراء الشقق والمنازل الصيفية
target: Wire transfer deposit without physical visit
description: Attractive apartment listings at unusually low rents in major Moroccan cities where the fake landlord claims to be abroad and insists on a deposit via money transfer before showing the keys.
advice: Never send money or deposits without an in-person visit inside the property and verifying the leaseholder's legal deed.

name: Romance / Cam-Model Sextortion Blackmail
name_ar: الابتزاز الجنسي عبر الفيديو وشبكات التواصل
target: Extortion money via money order or cryptocurrency
description: Perpetrator engages victim in romantic or sexual conversation, records video footage or screenshots, then threatens to distribute the video to family, friends, and employers unless a ransom is paid.
advice: Do NOT pay (extortion never stops after paying). Do not reply. Block the blackmailer and immediately report to police cybercrime unit.

name: Bogus Schengen / BLS / TLS Visa Appointment Broker
name_fr: Faux Courtier de Rendez-vous Visa BLS / TLS / VFS
name_ar: سماسرة مواعيد التأشيرة الوهمية (شنغن / إسبانيا / فرنسا)
target: Advance fees for bot appointments that don't exist
description: Individuals or fake agencies claiming to guarantee visa appointments or expedited Schengen visas in exchange for upfront payment through mobile wallets.
advice: Official appointment booking providers strictly forbid unauthorized third-party transfers. Many embassies cancel appointments booked with fake details.

name: Generic 'Account Suspended in 24 Hours' Phishing
name_ar: روابط التصيد بحجة تعليق الحساب خلال 24 ساعة
description: Generic phishing emails or SMS pretending to come from Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, or Netflix claiming your account will be deleted unless you verify credentials on their link.
advice: Inspect the URL domain closely. Never click urgent account verification links sent by SMS or unverified emails.

name: Fraudulent Charity & Sick Child Crowdfunding
name_fr: Fausse Campagne de Don Médical / Sadaqah
name_ar: احتيال التبرعات والصدقات لحالات مرضية مفبركة
target: Charity money transfers to private individual accounts
description: Emotional social media posts with stolen photos of hospitalized children or fake medical reports soliciting urgent transfers to personal bank accounts or cash transfers.
advice: Donate exclusively through verified, registered NGO foundations and hospital social service offices.

name: National Identity Card (CIN) Harvester Under Prize Guise
name_fr: Collecte Frauduleuse de Carte d'Identité Nationale (CIN)
name_ar: سرقة صورة البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف بدعوى إثبات الهوية للجوائز
description: Attacker requests high-resolution front and back photos of the Moroccan National Identity Card (CIN) supposedly to validate lottery winnings, microcredit, or remote job files. Stolen IDs are then used to open fraudulent bank accounts or SIM cards.
advice: Never send your National Identity Card to untrusted parties. Watermark any necessary ID copy with the specific purpose.
report_to: CNDP (Commission Nationale de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel), DGSN
